news.headline: Algeria to sever diplomatic ties with UAE
news.summary: The Algerian foreign ministry did not give a reason for the move but said it had exhausted all means.

news.headline: Trump administration proposes waiving grace period for H-1B holders after job loss
news.summary: <p>The Trump administration has proposed eliminating a 60-day grace period that allows certain immigrants, including skilled workers on H-1B visas, to stay in the United States and find a new sponsor after losing their job, according to a government notice posted online on Thursday.</p>

news.headline: UN expert Albanese, protesters warn against Italy’s anti-Semitism bill
news.summary: Protesters in Rome and UN Special Rapporteur Francesca Albanese, warn proposed law could silence criticism of Israel.

news.headline: 9/11: Drones light up NYC ahead of 25th anniversary
news.summary: A drone light show illuminated the New York City skyline Wednesday night during a test for the 'Tribute in Light' installation that will mark the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks. A total of 2,977 drones will take part in the display, one for each life lost on September 11, 2001.
